messages.sourceEnglish: Confirm a mapped site’s country before using its crop-planning guidance.
messages.text: Qinisekisa izwe lesayithi edwetshiwe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa isiqondiso sayo sokuhlela izitshalo.

messages.sourceEnglish: Keep your sowing records and nursery equipment while local planning is unavailable.
messages.text: Gcina amarekhodi akho okuhlwanyela nezinto zokusebenza zenkulisa yezitshalo ngenkathi ukuhlela kwendawo kungatholakali.

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Site country and region
Open your mapped site and confirm its country details. Country confirmation does not approve farming advice for a new region.
messages.text: Vula isayithi yakho edwetshiwe bese uqinisekisa imininingwane yezwe layo. Ukuqinisekisa izwe akugunyazi iseluleko sokulima sesifunda esisha.

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Planning without a mapped site
messages.text: Umhleli wezitshalo → Ukuhlela ngaphandle kwesayithi edwetshiwe

messages.sourceEnglish: For a virtual bed or local design, explicitly choose or remove the South African reference basis. The choice stays with that workspace.
messages.text: Kumbhede wokutshala owenziwe noma kumklamo wendawo, khetha ngokucacile noma ususe isisekelo sokubhekisela saseNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhetha kuhlala kuleyo ndawo yokusebenzela.
